# Errors and recovery

Every public failure has a stable category, a stable subcode, an explicit retry policy, offline recovery help, and a version-pinned guidance URL.

Generated from hSUM `0.1.0-alpha.4`.

Run `hsum help error SUBCODE` without network access for the same recovery text. Structured output also includes `details` and a request ID.
